patch.summary:
Choose AppDynamics only if your buying job matches “Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33” rather than ThorData's shape. Choose ThorData only if your buying job matches “Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit” rather than AppDynamics's shape. Workflow advantage: AppDynamics leans observability-monitoring; ThorData leans web-data-collection. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: AppDynamics is Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33/vCPU/mo annual; Enterprise $50/vCPU; often Cisco ; ThorData is Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit packs from ~$30..
- Company-size focus: AppDynamics (mid-market, enterprise) vs ThorData (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: AppDynamics-leaning observability-monitoring vs ThorData-leaning web-data-collection.
- Researched limits: AppDynamics — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); ThorData — Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs.

Limitations — AppDynamics: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); $6/vCPU Infrastructure is not the APM-relevant floor — Premium $33 is; ThorData: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs; Marketing claims should be validated — score from published packaging, not Fortune-500 slogans.

Poor-fit cases: AppDynamics is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · ThorData is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs · Avoid AppDynamics if you actually need ThorData's motion (Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper )
